description: This file defines interfaces related to warning reporting control, warning events, and warning reporting units within the WPEFramework namespace. It includes abstract classes for warning event handling, configuration, and management, facilitating warning reporting mechanisms.

classes.name: IWarningEvent
classes.description: Interface for warning event data encapsulation with methods for serialization, deserialization, categorization, and warning identification.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Interface representing a warning reporting unit responsible for managing warning events and categories.

classes.name: IWarningReportingUnit::IWarningReportingControl
classes.description: Interface for control objects used to configure warning reporting categories, including exclusion and configuration methods.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent
methods.description: Method to report a warning event associated with a specific identifier.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation
methods.description: Method to retrieve configuration details for a specific warning category.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList
methods.description: Method to include a warning reporting control object into the category list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList
methods.description: Method to remove a warning reporting control object from the category list.

methods.name: Exclude
methods.description: Method to exclude a category from reporting.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Method to set configuration options for warning categories.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Method to create a copy of the warning reporting control object.
